text: rachel (PM): Dropped a new compact-composer prototype focusing on streaming UX + token display. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/redwood/compact-composer-streaming. Goal: reduce clutter for embedded consoles while keeping controls discoverable. maria (Design): Looked it over. Two quick concerns: token badge is noisy in micro state, and the stop icon blends with message actions. Thinking we need a tiny separation and a subtle divider. sam (Eng): For token badge we can switch to a soft state: show only when >10 tokens or when user hovers. Also propose showing an "est." prefix during stream, like "~42 est." and then replace with exact after final chunk. Cheaper than recomputing tokens on every chunk. jia (DevEx): Accessibility: please don't rely on hover. On keyboard focus the token badge should appear. Also voice users should get periodic updates: "Streaming, approximate tokens: 42" but throttle to 300ms. Use aria-live polite and aria-atomic. maria (Design): How about label options: "Stop", "Halt", "Interrupt". Research favors "Interrupt" because it implies the model can be stopped but not necessarily thrown away. But UI space is tight. If we use an icon-only, add a visible tooltip and aria-label. sam (Eng): Icon suggestions: square stop () looks like media stop; a broken-play icon implies cancel. Technically easiest is an octagon with a small buffer so it differs from other action icons. I'll prototype both. rachel (PM): Mobile: we need a gesture for stop since no keyboard. Suggest long-press on the streaming bubble to show "Halt/Regenerate" actions. Thoughts? jia (DevEx): Long-press is good but not discoverable. Add a hint: long-press to interrupt shown once per session. Also ensure VoiceOver exposes an action for the bubble: "Perform: Interrupt generation". Use accessible actions API. maria (Design): Colors: token badge text should hit 4.5:1. Current badge bg #f2f4f7 with text #5b6168 is ~3.2. Proposed combos in fig comment: #252a34 on #ffffff (good) or #0f1720 on #f7f9fb. sam (Eng): Engineering note on estimator: we'll compute an approx token = ceil(char_count / 4.0) as a cheap fallback, update server-side exact on completion. We'll add a telemetry flag when estimator used so we can track accuracy and adjust ratio per language. jia (DevEx): SR behavior: use a hidden live region with role="status" and aria-live="polite". Example snippet: Streaming, approx 0 tokens Update text during streaming: "Streaming, approx 27 tokens" (throttled). On completion: "Generation complete 83 final token count: 31". maria (Design): Tooltip copy options I added to fig comments: "Interrupt (Esc)" vs "Pause (Esc)". I'll run a 20-person microtest for phrasing. sam (Eng): One more dev detail: when user hits regenerate mid-stream, we'll start a new request and show a subtle crossfade to avoid flash. KV cache stays unless user explicitly clears. Also keyboard: Esc = interrupt, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter = regenerate. We'll implement both hotkeys. rachel (PM): Nice. Can we surface the approximate badge with a tilde prefix instead of "est."? e.g., "~42" — shorter and familiar. Maria: check reading pattern in compact layout. maria (Design): Tilde is concise, but screen readers might read "tilde" unpredictably. For SR, aria-label should be "approx 42 tokens" even if visual is "~42". I'll annotate. deploy-bot: Preview deployed: https://preview.redwood.dev/compact-stream/1716801234 680 Please test keyboard, screen reader, and long-press flows. jia (DevEx): I'll make a short checklist for the PR: - Visible token badge on focus and hover (but available to SR always) - Visual shows "~N" during stream, aria reads "approx N tokens" - Live region role=status, aria-atomic=true, updates throttled to 250ms - Esc interrupts with confirmation toast (aria-live) - Cmd/Ctrl+Enter regenerates - Long-press action on mobile with one-time hint sam (Eng): I'll push a slim branch with estimator + keyboard handlers. Maria, can you add the compact icon spacing and a small divider? I'll wire the aria attributes. rachel (PM): Plan: A/B test "Interrupt" vs "Pause" copy and "~N" vs "N est." display. Targeting merge tomorrow afternoon. Thanks team :thumbsup:
